组织行为学专家雷·马乔里认为，领导者良好的幽默感可以提高团队……的质量。
A. 声明
B. 陈述
C. 信息
D. 沟通

items.question: Organizational behavior specialist Ray Majory believes a good sense of humor in a leader can increase the quality of ------- in the team.
